card.fact_statement: The Constitutional Court considered a petition from 36 senators seeking to disqualify Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra.
card.source_span: consideration of a petition from 36 senators that seeks to disqualify Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni waraka gani wa kisheria ambao Mahakama ya Kikatiba ilizingatia uliotaka kumvua sifa Waziri Mkuu Paetongtarn Shinawatra?
